behavior: Read-only tenant/role-gated preview derives exact title and description from the approved video preparation.
Owner/admin/editor must submit explicit privacy, child-audience and realistic synthetic-media choices plus metadata, audience, disclosure, rights and platform-rule acknowledgments.
Only approved YouTube Video content with the matching approved render and a current authorized connection can create an immutable, tenant-scoped review.
Review is bound to intent, account, revision, render, canonical metadata fingerprint and policy version; a different/expired review needs a fresh preparation.
Internal SUBMITTING transition rejects absent, expired, mismatched or tampered review and atomically stores the reviewed metadata in the attempt. No HTTP submission/worker/provider sender is enabled.

coveredBoundaries: JSONB key-order canonical fingerprint after database round trip
private privacy and explicit audience/synthetic disclosures in attempt snapshot

excluded: Initial policy integration failed because JSONB reordered nested keys; canonical object-key hashing fixed it, and the final focused suite passed.
An intermediate API build failed after a misplaced import; the import was fixed and the final API build passed.
limits: This is a bounded, manually acknowledged metadata gate, not automated semantic truth, rights, platform policy, quota or frequency certification.
The source policy version requires a maintainer update when the official platform reference changes; a 24-hour local review TTL alone cannot detect a remote policy change.
There is no account-connect/policy-review UI, authenticated upload sender, read-only reconciliation, scheduler or real account/post; full regression/native CI and live acceptance remain open.
